## What it is

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Rapids Water Park promises a fun-filled outing with friends or family, packed with aquatic adventures and memories to last a lifetime. A one-day admission to the park allows visitors to experience everything from thrilling water slides and a wave pool to a lazy river and dedicated kids’ areas, the perfect fun for any age!
